Drop one app onto another to make a folder. Needs drawer grouping.

How far you must move an app in the app drawer before it swaps position when reordering.
How far you must move an app inside a folder before it swaps position when reordering.
Threshold for the target area used when swapping positions. Larger makes it easier to form a folder; smaller makes it easier to insert between apps.
